rationale: Vehicle collision at traffic light resulting in totaled car and policyholder injuries, clear auto claim under collision coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder rear-ended at red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15am; vehicle totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed, other driver at fault and insurance info documented.

case_facts.description: rear-ended at red light by other driver going 35 mph who did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: car totaled, entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: yes, contains other driver's insurance info
